result_preview.title: Customer Order Fulfillment Tracking API

result_preview.description: This API exposes real-time customer order fulfillment data, enabling applications to retrieve order details, track shipment progress, and manage delivery status updates. It provides access to comprehensive order lifecycle information across customer accounts, supporting both order status queries and fulfillment event management for seamless customer service operations.
useCases: Sales team receives a new customer order and confirms it can be fulfilled based on account standing and delivery capability.
Order fulfillment process begins by validating customer eligibility and order specifications.

result_preview.title: Customer Order and Account Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Exposes customer accounts and orders for production scheduling and fulfillment tracking.
result_preview.description: This API provides access to customer account master data and production orders, enabling real-time retrieval of customer information and order status throughout the manufacturing execution lifecycle. The resource manages customer account hierarchies, order details, and fulfillment status to support production scheduling, quality inspection workflows, and OEE correlation analysis.
